name: hard-cut montage builds a character moment into climax
looks: A sequence of full-bleed cards hard-cuts through a backlit character silhouette with a spiky glowing crown, a pair of small glowing dots in two accent colours, a wash of saturated colour with a bold claim over it, a column of foreign-script glyphs, and the mark reshaped into an infinity loop, each card holding for under a second before the next lands, building toward a climax.
build: One full-bleed illustration or type card per unit, hard swapped on a stepped index with no crossfades; a consistent rim-light and floating particle shards carry across cards so the run reads as one continuous build rather than unrelated cuts, and the ring mark reappears mid-run reshaped as a figure-eight.
sound: A hit on every cut, a rising riser through the run, and a bigger hit on the last two or three cards as it peaks.
prompt: Build a short montage of full-bleed hard cuts around one dramatic figure or idea: a backlit silhouette, a wash of saturated colour with a bold claim, a few symbolic glyphs or marks, and the film's own mark reshaped into something new partway through, each card landing for under a second so the whole run reads as rising tension toward a peak.
